title: The Enterprise RAG Architect
subtitle: Questions and answers, from the mathematics of similarity to production systems
author: Dr. Dev
description: A growing library of questions and answers for architects and engineers who design retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems for real organisations. Each answer goes deep: the definitions, a careful derivation, diagrams, worked examples with real numbers, code you can run, the consequences for production systems, and the best videos, papers and books to read next. The questions build on one another — from the geometry of similarity, through vector indexes and hardware, to the design of complete enterprise RAG platforms.
